hints: Think about what summary statistics a box-and-whisker plot directly illustrates: quartiles, median, range, IQR, and skewness.
For the advantage, state that it clearly displays the spread, range, median, or shape of the distribution.
For the disadvantage, consider what information is lost: individual raw data values, sample size, or inability to calculate the mean and standard deviation.
walkthrough:
State one valid advantage of a box-and-whisker plot:
$$\text{Advantage: Clearly displays the spread, range, quartiles, median, and shape or skewness of the distribution.}$$

State one valid disadvantage of a box-and-whisker plot:
$$\text{Disadvantage: Individual data values are not visible, the sample size is not shown, and the mean or standard deviation cannot be calculated directly.}$$
teacher_walkthrough: We are asked to give one advantage and one disadvantage of using a box-and-whisker plot to represent a data set.

Step 1: Identify advantages.
A box-and-whisker plot summarizes a data set using five key statistics (minimum, lower quartile, median, upper quartile, maximum). Therefore, an advantage is that it gives a clear visual overview of the spread (IQR and range), the median, and any skewness in the distribution, allowing easy comparison between different groups.

Step 2: Identify disadvantages.
Because the plot condenses the data into only five numbers, the individual raw data points are lost. You cannot see how many observations were in the sample, and you cannot compute the mean or standard deviation from the box plot alone.

hints: Inspect the data values: notice the single extremely large value 768 minutes, while all other times are under 380 minutes.
Explain why the mean is unsuitable: it is heavily skewed and distorted upwards by this extreme outlier 768.
Explain why the mode is unsuitable: each of the 33 values occurs exactly once, so no mode exists.
Conclude that the median is the most suitable measure of central tendency because it is resistant to extreme outliers.
walkthrough:
Identify the most suitable average:
$$\text{The median is the most suitable measure of central tendency.}$$

Explain why the mean is less suitable:
$$\text{The mean is heavily distorted and skewed by the single very large outlier of 768 minutes.}$$

Explain why the mode is less suitable:
$$\text{The mode is unsuitable because all 33 recorded times are distinct, so no mode exists (frequencies are all 1).}$$
teacher_walkthrough: We need to evaluate whether the mean, mode, or median is the most suitable measure of central tendency for the 33 recorded times.

Step 1: Check for outliers affecting the mean.
The data set includes an extreme value of $768\text{ minutes}$, while the rest of the values are clustered between $190$ and $375\text{ minutes}$. The mean is sensitive to extreme values and will be pulled substantially higher by $768$, making it unrepresentative of the typical person's time.

Step 2: Check the mode.
Every recorded time is unique (frequency 1 for each value), meaning there is no repeating value. Therefore, no mode exists, so the mode cannot be used.

Step 3: Evaluate the median.
The median is the middle value ($280\text{ minutes}$). Because it depends only on the rank order of values, it is completely unaffected by the extreme outlier $768$. Thus, the median is the most appropriate measure of central tendency.

teacher_walkthrough: To draw the box-and-whisker plot, we use the five-number summary of the 33 times.

Step 1: State the five summary values:
- Minimum: $190$
- Lower quartile ($Q_1$): $256$ (or $256.5$)
- Median ($Q_2$): $280$
- Upper quartile ($Q_3$): $329$
- Upper boundary/maximum non-outlier: $375$

Step 2: Construct the central box:
Draw a rectangular box extending from $Q_1 = 256$ to $Q_3 = 329$. Draw a vertical line through the box at the median value $280$.

Step 3: Draw the whiskers:
Draw a horizontal whisker extending from the left edge of the box ($256$) to the minimum value ($190$). Draw a horizontal whisker extending from the right edge of the box ($329$) to $375$.
Step 4: Ensure the linear horizontal scale is accurately marked.
